civilian.empire.line.idle.0: Fine day for hauling, if you ask me. Nobody does.
civilian.empire.line.idle.1: I keep meaning to fix that fence.
civilian.empire.line.idle.2: Smell that? Somebody's burning the bread again.
civilian.empire.line.idle.3: My knees aren't what they were.
civilian.empire.line.idle.4: Wonder what the god thinks of us lot.
civilian.empire.line.idle.5: I could do with a proper meal.
civilian.empire.line.idle.6: Quiet today. I don't trust quiet.
civilian.empire.line.idle.7: One more trip and I'm sitting down.
civilian.empire.line.rain.1: Good for the crops, bad for my boots.
civilian.empire.line.rain.3: Smells like wet wool out here.
civilian.empire.line.night.1: Heard something out past the fields.
civilian.empire.line.night.2: I don't like the dark this far out.
civilian.empire.line.reply.1: Can't stop long, there's work to do.
civilian.empire.line.reply.2: Ask the bonfire, it knows more than me.
civilian.empire.line.reply.5: If it's about the turnips, it wasn't me.
civilian.empire.line.reply.6: Don't tell anyone, but I like it here.
civilian.empire.talk.0.0: Did you hear that last night?
civilian.empire.talk.2.0: Think the god's happy with us?
civilian.empire.talk.3.1: Traded a sack of oats for them.
civilian.empire.talk.4.1: My knee said so this morning.
civilian.empire.traveller.want.baked_pot: Got %s baked potatoes? Then I'm staying.
civilian.empire.traveller.want.cooked_po: %s cooked pork and you've got yourself a pair of hands.
civilian.empire.traveller.want.cooked_mu: Feed me %s cooked mutton and I'll stay.
civilian.empire.traveller.want.sweet_ber: %s sweet berries. Call it a down payment.
civilian.empire.traveller.want.cooked_co: Bring me %s cooked cod and I'll put down roots.
civilian.empire.traveller.not_enough: That's not all of it. I said %s.
civilian.empire.traveller.not_member: I'll wait for the folk who keep this fire.
civilian.empire.traveller.accepted: Right then. Where do I sleep?
civilian.empire.traveller.full: Looks like you've hands enough. I'll move on.
civilian.empire.traveller.leaving: No room for me, then. Fair enough.
